The Southword Debut Poetry Collection Award is an award offered by The Munster Literature Centre for the highest scoring debut collection of poetry that is shortlisted for, but does not win, The Farmgate Café Poetry Award. The award was first offered in 2023, and was won by poet Molly Twomey. The winning poet is awarded €1,000.
